svg.aria-label: Pelvic tilt force couples (teaching model): two pairs of muscles turn the pelvis about the hip joints — 骨盆倾斜的力偶（教学模型）：两对肌肉使骨盆绕髋关节转动

text.aria-label: Pelvic tilt force couples (teaching model): two pairs of muscles turn the pelvis about the hip joints — 骨盆倾斜的力偶（教学模型）：两对肌肉使骨盆绕髋关节转动
text.tspan: Pelvic tilt force couples (teaching model): two pairs of muscles turn the pelvis about the hip joints
骨盆倾斜的力偶（教学模型）：两对肌肉使骨盆绕髋关节转动

text.aria-label: A. Anterior tilt: lordosis increases — A. 前倾：腰椎前凸增加
text.tspan: A. 前倾：腰椎前凸增加

text.aria-label: Hip flexors (iliopsoas) — 屈髋肌（髂腰肌）
Hip joint: the pivot — 髋关节：转动中心
B. Posterior tilt: lordosis decreases — B. 后倾：腰椎前凸减少
text.tspan: B. 后倾：腰椎前凸减少

text.aria-label: Hip joint: the pivot — 髋关节：转动中心
A: erector spinae pull the back of the pelvis up while the hip flexors pull the front down, so the pelvis tips forward. — A：竖脊肌向上拉骨盆后部，屈髋肌向下拉骨盆前部，骨盆前倾。
text.tspan: A: erector spinae pull the back of the pelvis up while the hip flexors pull the front down, so the pelvis tips forward.
A：竖脊肌向上拉骨盆后部，屈髋肌向下拉骨盆前部，骨盆前倾。

text.aria-label: B: the abdominals pull the front up while gluteus maximus and the hamstrings pull the back down, so the pelvis tips back. — B：腹肌向上拉骨盆前部，臀大肌和腘绳肌向下拉骨盆后部，骨盆后倾。
text.tspan: B: the abdominals pull the front up while gluteus maximus and the hamstrings pull the back down, so the pelvis tips back.
B：腹肌向上拉骨盆前部，臀大肌和腘绳肌向下拉骨盆后部，骨盆后倾。

text.aria-label: Teaching model, not yet checked in a kinesiology textbook. Sourced: rectus abdominis works on posterior pelvic tilt; the deep abdominals may assist gluteus maximus in controlling anterior pelvic rotation. — 教学模型，尚未在运动学教材中核对。有来源的部分：腹直肌参与骨盆后倾；深层腹肌可能协助臀大肌控制骨盆前旋。
text.tspan: Teaching model, not yet checked in a kinesiology textbook. Sourced: rectus abdominis works on posterior pelvic tilt; the deep abdominals may assist gluteus maximus in controlling anterior pelvic rotation.
教学模型，尚未在运动学教材中核对。有来源的部分：腹直肌参与骨盆后倾；深层腹肌可能协助臀大肌控制骨盆前旋。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
